name: homeassistant
description: Home Assistant: WAN, gateway and box sensors, presence of chosen devices, and switches for chosen policies, over MQTT discovery

broker.description: the MQTT broker Home Assistant uses: host or host:port (1883, or 8883 with TLS)

tls_skip_verify.description: accept any broker certificate (self-signed); only on your own network

base_topic.description: where this box publishes its states; give each box its own

device_name.description: the device name in Home Assistant

interval_seconds.description: how often the states are sent

devices.description: MAC addresses of devices to track as home / not home (needs devices:read)

away_minutes.description: a device not seen for this long is not home
